title: Bathe & Wilson 10-bay, 9-storey plane frame eigenproblem

source.citation: Bathe, K.J., Wilson, E.L. (1972). Large Eigenvalue Problems in Dynamic Analysis. J. Eng. Mech. Div. ASCE 98(EM6):1471-1485.
source.where: Eigenvalues 0.589541, 5.52695, 16.5878 as quoted (independent reference column) in CSI SAP2000 Software Verification, Example 1-021 'Bathe and Wilson eigenvalue problem'; same data in the ETABS verification manual.
source.independence: Bathe & Wilson's own subspace-iteration results (1972); not a commercial program's output, not computed by stabileo or by this generator.

modelling: Euler-Bernoulli frames, one element per member, fixed bases; kip-ft data converted to SI.
Member mass lumped half to each end node in both translations (the 1972 mass model), carried by mass-only truss stubs; members have density 0. A consistent mass gives omega3^2 = 16.79 (+1.2%).
